exp006-oracle-gsm8k-extended-v2 是 Oracle GSM8K 4PL+γ IRT MCMC 实验，cron 报告进程已退出。Director 说"完成即汇报"，结果决定 GSM8K framing 方向。

1. SSH 到 cqa1-21977，读取日志最后 50 行：`tail -50 /tmp/irt_oracle_gsm8k_ext_v2.log`

- **gamma** (contamination effect) 及其 95% CI
- **rhat** (max across parameters)
- **ESS** (min across parameters)
- **PPP** (posterior predictive p-value)
- **coverage** (95% CI coverage)
- **MAE** (mean absolute error)
